locomotion:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game animation sprite atlas, genuinely transparent RGBA, square 2048x2048. Reference image: attached WWII gas-mask soldier concept is identity, costume and material reference. Draw detailed hand-painted realistic gritty 2D sprites, dark field-grey long worn greatcoat, dark olive steel helmet, olive rubber gas mask with smoked round lenses and filter, leather straps, cartridge pouches, boots. Closely preserve the reference silhouette, costume, weathered cloth and believable adult anatomy. Never use a 3D mannequin, cartoon or chibi proportions. Fixed side-view camera with subtle three-quarter torso, always facing screen RIGHT. Precisely 4 columns by 4 rows, equal square cells, generous transparent gutters, one complete character in every cell, constant scale about 400px tall in a 512px cell; bottom sole baseline at 470px within each cell. No text, labels, grid, floor, shadows, background, trails or overlapping cells. All helmets, feet, coats fit fully inside each cell.
Rows 1 and 2: eight consecutive frames of a LOOPING WALK, read left to right then next row: right-foot forward contact; compress/down; passing with bent lifted right leg and left planted; lift/up; left-foot forward contact; compress/down; passing with bent lifted left leg and right planted; lift/up. Real articulated knees and heel/toe changes, coat hem billows and alternates with the legs, straps and small chest pouches move subtly after each step, head very stable, torso subtle bob. These eight walk drawings are BODY LAYERS ONLY: omit both arms completely from the shoulder sockets downward, omit carried gun. Both shoulders and their coat seams remain clean for attachment of separate arm sprites. Omit slung back rifle, hip satchel, canteen and blanket roll because those will be separate animated equipment layers. Keep chest cartridge pouches, harness and coat attached to torso.
Row 3: four sequential full-body DASH frames facing right, NOT a roll: preparation low crouch; explosive forward lunge with near-horizontal forward-leaning torso and coat streaming backward; travelling low dash with trailing legs; braking recovery into stance. In this row draw both natural arms holding a recognizable wooden-stock PPSh with drum magazine close across chest; all equipment can be drawn in these four complete dash frames. Feet stay near ground, character never rotates or tumbles. Cloth flares with acceleration then settles on recovery. Maintain identity and fixed size.
Row 4: columns 1 and 2 two quiet IDLE body-layer drawings, breathing chest and slightly shifted cloth, same omitted arms and large equipment as walk; columns 3 and 4 two AIRBORNE body-layer poses with knees bent at different heights, same omitted arms and large equipment. True clean alpha transparency. Each cell contains exactly one coherent drawing; strict 4x4 atlas layout.
climb:

Match identity/costume and realistic hand-painted material style of reference Image 1 and sprite Image 2. This must have a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, with NO gradient, smoke, canvas, floor, cast shadow, decorative backdrop or drawn ladder. Exactly a TWO BY TWO equal grid, four isolated full-body soldiers at SAME scale, back view with gentle three-quarter orientation. Keep the SAME rifle on the back in every frame: WOODEN BUTT at LOWER LEFT, BLACK BARREL at UPPER RIGHT, strapped firmly diagonally; never flip or rotate the rifle to the opposite diagonal. Keep identical long tattered dark field-grey coat, helmet, mask strap, olive pouches, horizontal blanket roll at waist and boots. One consistent character, same proportions and lighting. No text, no labels, no frame lines. Every helmet and raised hand and both feet fully inside its cell.
TOP LEFT / frame1: RIGHT arm extended high above head gripping unseen rung; LEFT arm bent with hand at left shoulder height; LEFT knee lifted to waist while RIGHT leg hangs straight lower. Coat split reveals lifted left knee, hem falls toward right leg.
TOP RIGHT / frame2: transitional climbing pull: RIGHT arm elbow flexed, RIGHT hand near the top of helmet; LEFT hand now lifting to just above shoulder; LEFT foot placed onto invisible rung under pelvis, RIGHT knee begins lifting. Coat gathers at thighs, blanket and canteen hang slightly left.
BOTTOM LEFT / frame3: clear OPPOSITE pose from frame1. LEFT ARM EXTENDED HIGH ABOVE HEAD on the left side; RIGHT arm bent with hand at right shoulder height; RIGHT knee lifted to waist and LEFT leg hanging straight lower. This left hand MUST be the high hand; no raised right hand in this cell. Head and rifle remain in same orientation, only limbs alternate.
BOTTOM RIGHT / frame4: transitional return: LEFT elbow flexed with LEFT hand near helmet top, RIGHT hand reaching just above right shoulder; RIGHT foot on invisible rung under pelvis, LEFT knee starts rising. Coat, straps, satchel, bedroll and canteen move slightly after the body in a convincing way, keep attachment and exact objects.
Draw distinct proper climbing weight shifts and visible bent fingers clasping invisible rungs. Realistic detailed painterly game sprites, not a 3D mannequin, no glow. True clean transparency and spacious gutters.
